title: nail's `jemalloc` feature uses the old `jemallocator` crate
body:
nail's optional `jemalloc` feature pulls in `jemallocator = "0.3"` and sets it as the global allocator in nail/src/main.rs. Development on `jemallocator` moved to the `tikv-jemallocator` crate.

## Proposal

Switch the feature to `tikv-jemallocator`, then build with `--features jemalloc` to confirm.
